title: m1-gap-segment-accounting-repair
summary: Pre-REC-C2 confidence repair. FIND-C1.8-01: a durable segment containing a Gap cannot be reopened because the header count (every persisted SegmentEntry = records + gaps, from buffer.len()) disagrees with the replay validator (ExecutionRecord entries only). Characterization measured 4 declared vs 3 actual. Fix: one unit for writer/header/replay, header field renamed record_count -> entry_count (byte layout unchanged, no data migration). Makes the #[ignore]-marked C1.8 UAT uat_rec_c1_03_forced_gap_reports_gap_detected GREEN and adds GAP-PERSIST-1..6.
pre_existing_flakes_handled: chronos-native lib tests require --test-threads=1 (ptrace collisions; documented in AGENTS.md §6.5)
archive_convention: rec-c1/m1 stream uses archive_status=ready; no .sddk-knowledge/changes/archive/m1-gap-* directory.

cc_drift.CC#39_pre_existing_intentional: cycles/index.md Total cycles vs filesystem. Pre-existing; belongs in a separate gov-* cycle (do NOT silently mask).
cc_drift.CC#18_rec_c1_7_pre_existing: rec-c1-7-projection-authority-acceptance missing verify-findings.json (C1.7 gap). gov-* owns the backfill.

notes: Cycle opened off main@4e0a1344 immediately after REC-C1.8 closure, at the user's direction, before starting REC-C2. Root cause is fully characterized before any fix is written: writer counts entries, replay counts records. This cycle closes FIND-C1.8-01 and un-ignores the C1.8 forced-gap UAT. Closure also flips FIND-C1.8-01 in the REC-C1.8 verify-findings from open_deferred to closed.
